title: How to Get a 7 in IB Psychology: A Study Plan
summary: Learn how to get a 7 in IB Psychology with an eight-week study plan covering assessment objectives, command terms, research and exam technique.
body_markdown:
Getting a 7 in IB Psychology requires more than memorizing theories and famous studies. You need accurate knowledge, selective evidence, direct application, critical evaluation, and enough timed practice to produce all of this under exam conditions.


There is also an important syllabus distinction. The course first assessed in **2027** differs from the course receiving its final assessments in **2026** . This guide focuses mainly on the 2027 course while identifying necessary adjustments for November 2026 candidates.


### Start with the correct IB Psychology syllabus


Before building an IB Psychology study plan, confirm your examination session and level. The[official IB Psychology course page](https://www.ibo.org/programmes/diploma-programme/curriculum/individuals-and-societies/psychology/) identifies the previous course as having its final assessment in 2026, while the revised course has its first assessment in May 2027.


Course Main assessment structure


Final assessment in 2026 Paper 1 covers the biological, cognitive and sociocultural approaches. Paper 2 covers options. HL also takes Paper 3 on research approaches. The IA is an experimental study report.


First assessment in 2027 Paper 1 integrates concepts, content and contexts. Paper 2 focuses on research methodology and class practicals. HL also takes Paper 3 on data analysis. The IA is a research proposal.


Do not mix resources from the two courses. An old Paper 2 essay on abnormal psychology, for example, does not match the purpose of Paper 2 in the 2027 course. RevisionDojo provides separate pathways through its[IB Psychology resources](https://www.revisiondojo.com/ib/ib-psychology) and[2027 Psychology revision notes](https://www.revisiondojo.com/ib/ib-psychology-new/notes) .


### What a grade 7 requires


The IB does not award a 7 for complicated terminology or the largest number of memorized studies. A 7 reflects strong performance across the assessed components, and grade boundaries can change between examination sessions. Focus on maximizing marks rather than aiming for an assumed percentage.


The[official 2027 Psychology subject brief](https://ibo.org/globalassets/new-structure/programmes/dp/pdfs/dp_psychology_subjectbrief_en.pdf) organizes assessment around three objectives:


Assessment objective What it means in practice


**AO1: Knowledge and understanding** Define concepts accurately, explain theories and understand the three approaches and research methodology.


**AO2: Application and analysis** Apply knowledge to the precise prompt, analyse theories and connect research to an argument. HL students also interpret data.


**AO3: Synthesis and evaluation** Evaluate research, compare evidence, critique claims, justify conclusions and design appropriate research.


Students often remain around a 5 because they demonstrate AO1 but apply or evaluate inconsistently. Their psychology may be correct, yet not sufficiently connected to the question. Every paragraph should perform a clear function within the argument.


### Know what each paper tests


For the 2027 course, SL students complete Paper 1 and Paper 2, each worth **35%** , while the IA is worth **30%** . At HL, Paper 1 and Paper 2 are each worth **25%** , Paper 3 is worth **30%** , and the IA is worth **20%** .


### Paper 1: concepts, content and contexts


Paper 1 lasts **1 hour 30 minutes** and is worth 35 marks. Section A contains two compulsory short-answer questions from two of the biological, cognitive and sociocultural content areas. Section B applies psychology to unseen situations from health and well-being, human development, human relationships, and learning and cognition.


Section C contains concept-based extended responses. SL students answer one of two questions, while HL students answer both. Responses connect evidence, content and contexts with concepts such as **bias, causality, change, measurement, perspective and responsibility** .


### Paper 2: research methodology


Paper 2 lasts **1 hour 30 minutes** and is worth 35 marks. Section A asks four questions about class practicals, while Section B requires evaluation of an unseen study using two or more concepts.


The four practical methods are linked to four contexts:


- Health and well-being: interview or focus group
- Human development: observation
- Human relationships: survey or questionnaire
- Learning and cognition: experiment


The[IB Psychology curriculum update](https://www.ibo.org/university-admission/latest-curriculum-updates/psychology-updates/) confirms that both SL and HL students complete these practicals. Keep a one-page record for each covering its aim, sample, procedure, operationalization, ethics, findings, limitations and possible redesign.


### Paper 3: HL data analysis


HL Paper 3 lasts **1 hour 45 minutes** and is worth 30 marks. It uses quantitative and qualitative sources connected to an HL extension involving culture, motivation or technology. Practise identifying trends, distinguishing correlation from causation, evaluating credibility and synthesizing findings from several sources.


### Treat command terms as instructions


Command terms specify the required response. Ignoring them can limit a knowledgeable answer because explanation, discussion and evaluation are not interchangeable.


Command term Required approach


**Describe** Give an accurate, detailed account.


**Explain** Show how or why something occurs.


**Apply** Use psychology in relation to the given scenario.


**Analyse** Break information into elements and explain relationships.


**Compare and contrast** Address similarities and differences using both items throughout.


**Discuss** Present a balanced review and reach a supported conclusion.


**Evaluate** Weigh strengths and limitations, then make a judgment.


**To what extent** Judge how far a claim is supported and defend that conclusion.


**Design** Produce a coherent research plan suited to the aim.


Underline the command term and convert it into a task statement. “Evaluate one cognitive explanation of memory” means explaining the mechanism, using research to test it, assessing that evidence and judging how convincing the explanation is.


### Build a flexible evidence bank


Do not memorize studies as isolated stories. Connect each study to possible concepts, content areas, contexts and evaluation points.


For each study, learn:


- Aim, participants and method
- Essential procedure and principal result
- Conclusion supported by the result
- Two question-specific strengths or limitations
- The theories, concepts or contexts it can address


The final connection is crucial. If leading questions influenced memory reports, explain how this supports reconstructive memory, whether measurement or demand characteristics affected the result, and whether the design permits a causal conclusion.


A compact set of adaptable studies is more useful than dozens of poorly understood examples. Use[IB Psychology Flashcards](https://www.revisiondojo.com/ib/ib-psychology-new/flashcards) for retrieval, but regularly answer without prompts. Recognition is not the same as recall.


### Write arguments, not study summaries


A strong extended paragraph can follow this sequence:


1. **Claim:** Answer part of the question.
2. **Explanation:** Explain the relevant theory or mechanism.
3. **Evidence:** Include only details needed to support the claim.
4. **Link:** Show how the evidence supports or qualifies the argument.
5. **Evaluation:** Assess an issue affecting interpretation.
6. **Judgment:** Return to the wording of the question.


Evaluation must be specific. “The sample was small, so validity was low” is often inaccurate. Sample size may affect representativeness, statistical power or transferability, depending on the method. Identify the limitation, explain its consequence and state which conclusion becomes less certain.


A laboratory experiment may control confounding variables and strengthen causal inference, but an artificial task might reduce ecological validity. The importance of each point depends on whether the question concerns causality, measurement or real-world application.


Use the[RevisionDojo Psychology Questionbank](https://www.revisiondojo.com/ib/ib-psychology-new/questionbank) for topic practice. Classify lost marks as knowledge, application, evaluation, structure or timing errors instead of recording only the score.


### An eight-week IB Psychology study plan


This plan assumes **5-6 hours per week** , divided into focused sessions and one longer timed task. If time is limited, combine adjacent weeks while preserving the sequence.


Week Main focus Required output


**1** Syllabus audit and diagnosis Traffic-light each area, complete timed short and extended responses, and begin an error log.


**2** Three approaches Build concept maps and the evidence bank. Complete three short answers and one essay plan.


**3** Contexts and application Apply the approaches to at least four unfamiliar scenarios without notes.


**4** Methods and practicals Create records for all four practicals. Review ethics, sampling and redesign.


**5** Paper 1 integration Complete timed short answers, scenario applications and one extended response.


**6** Paper 2 evaluation Analyse unseen studies using concepts including bias, causality and measurement.


**7** HL Paper 3 or SL repair HL interprets mixed data. SL repairs weak areas and completes another timed section.


**8** Simulation and repair Sit full papers, classify errors and retest weaknesses 48 hours later.


A practical weekly pattern combines content repair, retrieval, one exam-style response, research methods, a ten-minute essay plan and a timed weekend section. Reviewing the work should take nearly as long as completing it.


Jojo AI can help identify missing explanation, application or evaluation, but compare its feedback with teacher guidance and official expectations. The objective is independent accuracy rather than dependence on suggestions.


### Make the IA contribute to the 7


Under the 2027 course, the IA is a **research proposal worth 30% at SL and 20% at HL** . You design a study using one of the four class-practical methods, but you do not conduct the proposed research.


A strong proposal aligns the population, sampling, procedure, measurement, ethics and analysis with the research question. Justify each choice and acknowledge limitations that genuinely follow from the design.


Students assessed in 2026 complete an experimental study report instead. They should follow the older requirements in the[official 2019 Psychology subject brief](https://www.ibo.org/globalassets/new-structure/programmes/dp/pdfs/psychology-2019.pdf) , not the new research-proposal format.


### Common mistakes that prevent a 7


- **Rereading instead of retrieving:** Close your notes and reproduce the material from memory.
- **Using every remembered study:** Select evidence because it answers the prompt.
- **Giving generic evaluation:** Explain which conclusion each limitation weakens.
- **Ignoring unfamiliar scenarios:** Topic knowledge alone is insufficient for application.
- **Neglecting research methods:** Methodology affects Paper 2, the IA and HL analysis.
- **Writing without timing:** Untimed quality does not guarantee paper completion.
- **Memorizing model answers:** A changed concept or context can make them irrelevant.
- **Treating predicted papers as forecasts:** Use[IB Psychology predicted papers](https://www.revisiondojo.com/predicted-papers/ib-psychology-new) as practice, not exact predictions.


### Conclusion


To get a 7 in IB Psychology, combine accurate AO1 knowledge with AO2 application and AO3 evaluation that produces supported judgments. Build a flexible evidence bank, master command terms, document the practicals and use timed work to identify recurring weaknesses.


RevisionDojo can support this routine through Study Notes, Flashcards, the Questionbank, Jojo AI and Predicted Papers or Mock Exams. Use each tool for a defined purpose, then check progress through independent timed performance.
